pages.text: Every conversion gem is crafted around a star, and the star comes back: it is a reusable catalyst. Better bees need better stars, and a better star works in any weaker star's recipe.$(br2)$(l)Lesser Bubba Star bees:$()$(br)$(l:lesser/stone)Stone Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/dirt)Dirt Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/nature)Nature Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/forest)Forest Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/desert)Desert Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/river)River Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/meadow)Meadow Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/jungle)Jungle Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/taiga)Taiga Bee$(/l), $(l:lesser/savanna)Savanna Bee$(/l).

$(l)Bubba Star bees:$()$(br)$(l:bubba/amethyst)Amethyst Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/obsidian)Obsidian Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/glow)Glow Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/mesa)Mesa Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/swamp)Swamp Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/frost)Frost Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/lush_caves)Lush Caves Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/deep_dark)Deep Dark Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/mushroom_fields)Mushroom Fields Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/sea)Sea Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/coral)Coral Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/prismarine)Prismarine Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/corrupt_stone)Corrupt Stone Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/soul)Soul Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/corrupt_nature)Corrupt Nature Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/magma)Magma Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/ender)Ender Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/royal_guard)Royal Guard Bee$(/l), $(l:bubba/starlight)Starlight Bee$(/l).
The Lesser Bubba Star is used up here.

$(l)Celestial Bubba Star bees:$()$(br)$(l:celestial/coal)Coal Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/copper)Copper Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/iron)Iron Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/gold)Gold Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/redstone)Redstone Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/lapis)Lapis Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/emerald)Emerald Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/quartz)Quartz Bee$(/l), $(l:celestial/ancient_debris)Ancient Debris Bee$(/l).$(br2)The $(l:rituals/royal_queen)Royal Queen$(/l) has no gem: she is summoned by a ritual.
Not crafted: a Bubba Star becomes celestial in the $(l:rituals/night)Celestial Ritual$(/l), one night under open sky. Every ore bee's gem needs it.
